key_insight: BMuon modifies Muon’s spectral geometry so Transformer MLP hidden channels compete for a shared budget, improving structured compressibility.
engineering_relevance: BMuon targets training Transformers that better tolerate MLP channel pruning, with learned allocations that can guide channel removal.
method: Use a global channel-allocation budget to interpolate between Muon’s geometry and structured sparse geometries.
Derive an exact normalized steepest-descent oracle and a practical minorization-maximization allocation surrogate.
Prove that sufficiently scarce budgets make every minimum-cost representation width-minimal in linear factorization models.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improvements over Muon under gradual MLP pruning for ViT-S/16 on ImageNet-1K and post-training MLP pruning for a 1B-parameter LLaMA-style model on FineWeb; learned allocations also outperform weight magnitude as a pruning criterion.
watch_item: The width-minimality guarantee applies to linear factorization models, while the abstract does not quantify Transformer gains or allocation-surrogate overhead.
paper_title: BMuon: Budgeting Muon's Spectral Geometry for Structured Compressibility
